first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The area of sky beyond the horizon, blue at the beginning, with only a small light, bright area visible along the lower edge of the inverted image in the final frame.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A large expanse of light yellow-brown ground, with short grass alternating with bare soil and a rough light-and-dark texture.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Includes two larger roadside trees and small trees and shrubs scattered in the distance; of the two nearby crowns, one is dark and the other light.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A brown, band-shaped dirt road crossing the Dry Grassland, with linear light and dark areas on parts of the road surface and darkening from tree shadows.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Multiple dark arcs arranged in nested or overlapping groups on the light-colored ground.
